fact: A December 2025 workshop convened by the Botswana Digital & Innovation Hub prepared groundwork ahead of the establishment of a Digital Services Authority that will take responsibility for formal implementation and oversight of the Open Data Policy, with an Open Data Portal for researchers and innovators to be established.
title: The Botswana Digital & Innovation Hub yesterday convened stakeholders from academia, research institutions, private sector, and many more from the innovation ecosystem in a workshop that discussed Open Data Hackathon.
